The following is a list of chapters from the [[Pokémon Quiz Puzzle Land: Pikachu is a Famous Detective]] manga. Two volumes were released under the '''{{j|てんとう虫コミックススペシャル}}''' ''Tentōmusi Comics Special'' label from 2008 to 2009 and two volumes were released under the '''{{j|Big Korotan}}''' label from 2013 to 2015. Altogether, the four compiled volumes contain 65 regular chapters and one bonus chapter.

==Volume 1 (Tentōmusi Comics Special)==
